text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Prez, did you know?
Apparently today is Father's Day!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Like, be my daddy already!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To Teio's father?
I don't quite understand what you mean...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds good, sounds good!
Hey, hey, if the Prez was your dad, how do you think he'd raise me?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what it'll look like, huh...?
I don't think I'll be doing anything special.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I merely love them and watch over their growth.
Just as I treat all the other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Strict neutrality. I want my beloved daughter to learn an attitude of impartiality that does not give her own child special treatment.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, so you don't play favorites?
That's my Papa for you!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Now, now...
I am not your papa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (...Teio... and the President...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (...Wait, that might actually come in handy.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ryan. Today's Father's Day, so...
you're the dad, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eh, what do you mean by "I know, right"?
What's going on...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Papa... no?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A-All right, fine. I don't know why,
but Dober, you've always suddenly wanted to play weird games ever since we were little...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if you were a dad, Ryan,
how would you raise me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Like what, you ask? Uh, well... Playing soccer together, playing basketball, or maybe having a game of catch?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...All sports, all the time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-It can't be helped... I mean,
I don't know Papa's way of doing things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Still, you play along with any sport until the kids get tired of it, and you give it your all in other games too...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Ryan... when we were little, you always
did that for me. Whenever my parents weren't around,
you'd keep me company until I got tired of it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Ryan.
You really are... like a dad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's not it!
I'm only being "Dad" for today, okay?
